acceptance_criteria: The arbitrary-N Laughlin polynomial, minimal-coupling identity, general Laguerre eigenfunctions, arbitrary-m angle correlation, and magnetic scales pass independent algebraic checks.
The general formulas reduce to existing special cases where an independent implementation is already available.
The numerical path reads no paper, source image, author code, author array, or digitized reference and does not promote scientific coverage.
All 18 target outputs and figures are generated without reading raw/ or reference images.
The LLL spectrum is degenerate at Omega_rot/omega=1 to 1e-12.
All analytic densities and angle correlations normalize to one within declared grid tolerance.
The relative m=2 density peaks at sqrt(2) p_HO.
The quartic avoided-crossing gap equals 2|alpha| for the independently derived Gaussian coefficient at the zero crossing.
Every generated occupation remains within its physical probability bounds.
